headline: 愛丁堡藝穗節評論三則
context: 愛丁堡藝穗節（Edinburgh Fringe）評論這幾天一則接一則：舞台劇《Blackbox》講述亨利·布朗（Henry 'Box' Brown）1849年裝箱逃離維吉尼亞奴隸制、寄送自己到費城的真實故事。另兩齣戲則分別聚焦倫敦東區一間老酒吧的歇業故事，以及一齣以劇評人鬼魂纏身為題材的偽紀錄片恐怖片。

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: Underbelly, Edinburgh The story of Henry ‘Box’ Brown, who succeeded in mailing himself out of bondage, is recounted rather than fully dramatised Henry “Box” Brown is wrapped up in chains when he has an idea to claim his freedom. As inspiration hits him, actor Josiah Alpher flexes his muscles and, miraculously, the chains appear to pass through his neck. Magic! It is a neat visual metaphor for a true story that seems miraculous in itself. In 1849, Brown made a break to flee slavery near Richmond, Virginia, by posting himself in a wooden crate to Philadelphia, a state where ownership of human beings had been phased out by the Gradual Abolition Act of 1780. Alpher describes a painful journey, squashed, upturned and knocked about, before Brown’s happy delivery . Continue reading...
sources.title: Blackbox review – a legendary escape from slavery is told with magic tricks

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: Underbelly, George Square, Edinburgh A real-life pub closure inspires a sensitive and subtle drama about friendship and community by John Dinneen Two years ago, it was reported that a pub in Barking called The Jolly Fisherman had found a buyer after five years of dereliction. The prospective owner was a Muslim charity, which planned to turn a former business based on alcohol into a place of abstinence. In one respect, a building that had been the focus of community life in this part of east London for 150 years would continue to be the focus of community life. In another respect, the community had changed. Continue reading...
sources.title: The Jolly Fisherman review – last orders for an east London boozer in tense tale

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: This mockumentary from low-budget horror veteran Richard Mansfield isn’t the most subtle take on the artist-critic relationship but it has a certain sprightliness Where Quentin Dupieux’s 2023 theatre hostage-taking comedy Yannick pointed out that inside every punter is a critic, this no-frills British mockumentary suggests that if artists aren’t literally haunted by their reviews, then their inner critic might be just as deadly. It begins as a documentary crew arrive to chart theatre director Martin Beswick (Jonathan Cleaver) and his new production of MR James’s A Warning to the Curious at Nottingham’s Hounds Gate theatre (in real life, filmed at the city’s Arts theatre). He’s getting to grips with his cast, mostly amateurs apart from egomaniac thesp Colin Collins (Matthew Hunt). One day during rehearsals, one of the auditorium seats suddenly flips up, is eerily cold to the touch and has pistachio shells scattered underneath. The old ham Colin seizes the opportunity for an old Hounds Gate tale: about Cyril Cobb, a legendarily vicious director who sat in that very berth to critique other productions – hence his nickname, “Stalls”. After dying in a freak pistachio-swallowing accident, he has now apparently become, Overlook Hotel-style, part of the furniture. Captured in spectral audio recordings, he is heard opining that this new staging is: “Not … good … enough!” Continue reading...
sources.title: The Hounds Gate Haunting review – a ghostly critic lurks in the stalls in this suspenseful spooker

thread_text:
愛丁堡藝穗節（Edinburgh Fringe）這幾天評論一則接一則。舞台劇《Blackbox》，講述亨利·布朗（Henry 'Box' Brown）1849年把自己裝進木箱、從維吉尼亞里奇蒙寄往費城逃離奴隸制的真實故事，演員喬西亞·阿爾佛（Josiah Alpher）擔綱演出，用魔術手法呈現整段旅程。倫敦東區一間老酒吧歇業，也催生了新劇《The Jolly Fisherman》，講述真實的社區變遷故事。低成本恐怖片《The Hounds Gate Haunting》則以偽紀錄片形式，講一名劇評人鬼魂纏著諾丁漢劇院不放。

—— 本則整理自 The Guardian 於 2026 年 8 月 17 日發佈的報導，讓圖書館員翻譯給你聽。

voice_text: 愛丁堡藝穗節的評論，這幾天一則接一則。舞台劇《Blackbox》，講的是亨利·布朗，1849年把自己裝進木箱，從維吉尼亞逃出奴隸制、寄送到費城的真實故事，演出用魔術手法呈現整段旅程。倫敦東區有間老酒吧歇業，也催生了一齣新戲，講社區跟著改變的故事。還有一部低成本偽紀錄片恐怖片，講一名劇評人鬼魂，纏著諾丁漢的劇院不放。
